en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European spa or resort town nestled in a narrow valley surrounded by densely forested hills. Multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with mansard and gabled roofs line curving streets and a central park-like area in the foreground. Coniferous forests cover the surrounding slopes, and there is no visible modern high-rise construction or vehicles, giving it an early‑20th‑century appearance. The image is bordered in black like an old photographic postcard. No legible text appears on the front.
